What to look for

  • Greyscale: can you still tell Thriving from Drifting? The design spec requires states to read without colour (GS-03).
  • Scale: planets are 16–26px on a phone. Detail that only shows when inspecting large won't register in orbit.
  • Labels: rings and moons widen a planet, so names may hide more often where orbits overlap.
  • Calm: the app promises "no feeds, no noise". Spin and the overdue pulse should feel ambient, not urgent.

When you're happy, copy the settings and send them to Claude, or keep the app open in another tab to see changes live.
